what: Each time the pointer hovers a button, the icon inside (or the whole circle button) makes one full turn (360°) from 0° in .7s — an ease-in curve, so it starts slowly and ends fast. It does not rewind when the pointer leaves

options.min: Only runs in windows at least this width (px) — original is 1024
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Rotating child (icon). If absent, the whole element rotates (round circle button)
options.back: If on, on release it rewinds to 0° with the same length and curve (the original used a CSS transition) — default is no rewind

from.where: shared.js header pill button icon · footer SNS · white pill button (.js-button .-icon), PLANS TOP · PAGE TOP · order circle button as a whole (.js-buttonCircle) — rotate 0→360, .7s, Power1.easeIn, 1024px and up
